purpose: The declared family of strategy variants for the data-snooping tests (Hansen SPA / White Reality Check, Romano-Wolf stepdown, model confidence set, PBO, deflated Sharpe with an effective number of trials). Declared before any variant was run; scripts/variant_family.py runs exactly this list. Results are reported whatever they are, and the primary design (profile v33) is NOT re-chosen from them: a preferred variant could only ever be tested on fresh data.
series: main-backtest daily net returns on the dev calendar (entries 2023-07-01 -> 2025-12-31, open positions run off), one column per variant; days a variant is flat count as zero return

grid.why: the three hand-set trading thresholds, which were chosen across versions on this same data

toggles.name: regime_gate_on
toggles.why: the v10/v11 gate fitted on now-test windows

toggles.name: cusum_gate_on
toggles.why: entry gate tried in earlier versions

toggles.name: hurst_gate_on
toggles.why: entry gate tried in earlier versions

toggles.name: ranker_gbm
toggles.why: the learned ranker (gradient-boosted trees) switched on

toggles.name: open_fills
toggles.why: t+1 open instead of t+1 close fills

benchmarks: zero (cash; returns are excess of cash)
tests.spa: Hansen (2005) SPA, studentized (omega_k from the stationary-bootstrap kernel), lower/consistent/upper p-values; White (2000) Reality Check as the non-studentized upper p-value
tests.stepdown: Romano-Wolf (2005) StepM with Romano & Wolf (2016) adjusted p-values, studentized within each resample
tests.mcs: Hansen, Lunde & Nason (2011) model confidence set, size 0.10, statistics T_R and T_max, on volatility-normalised returns
tests.pbo: Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado & Zhu (2017) CSCV, 10 blocks
tests.dsr: deflated Sharpe with N = the entropy effective rank of the variants' correlation matrix and the empirical variance of the variants' Sharpe ratios; DSR-vs-N curve
tests.bootstrap: stationary bootstrap (Politis & Romano 1994), 10,000 resamples, seed 42, block length = ceil of the largest Politis-White stationary length across the series (fixed before running)
